hints.title: Hierarchical Purchase Discount
hints.text: Purchasing stock at a parent node unlocks a half-price discount for all its immediate subordinates.

hints.title: Subtree Budget Combination
hints.text: Combine child subtrees knapsack-style across allocated budget segments for each employee node.

hints.title: Discount Eligibility States
hints.text: Return two budget arrays per node: one assuming full cost purchase, and another assuming the parent unlocked discount pricing.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maxProfit(
        self,
        n: int,
        present: List[int],
        future: List[int],
        hierarchy: List[List[int]],
        budget: int,
    ) -> int:
        tree = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v in hierarchy:
            tree[u - 1].append(v - 1)

        def dfs(u: int):
            no_disc = [0] * (budget + 1)
            with_disc = [0] * (budget + 1)
            for v in tree[u]:
                c_no, c_with = dfs(v)
                new_no = [0] * (budget + 1)
                new_with = [0] * (budget + 1)
                for b1 in range(budget + 1):
                    for b2 in range(budget + 1 - b1):
                        new_no[b1 + b2] = max(new_no[b1 + b2], no_disc[b1] + c_no[b2])
                        new_with[b1 + b2] = max(
                            new_with[b1 + b2], with_disc[b1] + c_with[b2]
                        )
                no_disc = new_no
                with_disc = new_with

            res0 = no_disc[:]
            res1 = no_disc[:]

            fc = present[u]
            fp = future[u] - fc
            for b in range(fc, budget + 1):
                res0[b] = max(res0[b], with_disc[b - fc] + fp)

            hc = present[u] // 2
            hp = future[u] - hc
            for b in range(hc, budget + 1):
                res1[b] = max(res1[b], with_disc[b - hc] + hp)

            return res0, res1

        r0, _ = dfs(0)
        return max(r0)
```

complexity.notes: Tree DP with bounded knapsack merging at each node.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive binary choices across n employees require 2^n evaluations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Table memoization groups subtree decisions by allocated monetary units.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate bottom-up tree DP with parent condition dependency.
